rows.name: USDD

Mint its stable asset against collateral and repay the mint with the full $250.00 position. a CDP's ledger is its vaults: opening one and repaying it is the protocol's own unit of use. About 20 minutes, $0.20 in gas for the two transactions.
Repeat the core action once a week for 9 weeks: same position, same size, one transaction each week ($0.10 gas a week). Weekly use is what separates a real user from a one-off wallet touch.

Check the position every week on the protocol's own page and keep a screenshot of the balance: if the position is not showing, fix it before the next weekly action, while the gas is still cheap. About 5 minutes a week, no gas.

Do one second, different action inside the same protocol — a second pool, market or vault — with a quarter of the position ($62.50). A second touchpoint inside one protocol costs one more transaction ($0.10) and shows breadth, not just repetition.

Prepare the exit in the last week: confirm the withdrawal path works with a $1 test withdrawal first, then plan the full exit for the day the hold ends. One test transaction, $0.10 in gas, 10 minutes.

Add liquidity to its deepest pool and swap through it once a week with the full $50.00 position. a DEX records makers and takers; providing liquidity and routing a swap through the pool is the activity its own ledger can see. About 20 minutes, $1.00 in gas for the two transactions.
Repeat the core action once a week for 4 weeks: same position, same size, one transaction each week ($0.50 gas a week). Weekly use is what separates a real user from a one-off wallet touch.

Check the position every week on the protocol's own page and keep a screenshot of the balance: if the position is not showing, fix it before the next weekly action, while the gas is still cheap. About 5 minutes a week, no gas.

Do one second, different action inside the same protocol — a second pool, market or vault — with a quarter of the position ($12.50). A second touchpoint inside one protocol costs one more transaction ($0.50) and shows breadth, not just repetition.

Prepare the exit in the last week: confirm the withdrawal path works with a $1 test withdrawal first, then plan the full exit for the day the hold ends. One test transaction, $0.50 in gas, 10 minutes.

Net: $4.00 gas total (8 transactions on Proton at $0.50 each) + $50.00 capital locked for 30 days and withdrawable + 100 minutes of active time. Verdicts by plan size: $50 plan MARGINAL (gas is 8% of capital), $250 plan WORTH IT, $1,000 plan WORTH IT; cost $2.40 per active hour. Expected launch value $239.1K at 5% launch odds — the plan costs gas, it never promises a payout.
